items.question: What is TallyNudge?
items.answer: TallyNudge is a dark, tactile tally counter and clicker for iOS and Android. Package: com.zuki.apps.tallynudge.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Counters stay on your device. Crash and usage diagnostics go to Firebase.

items.question: What is included for free?
items.answer: Up to 4 counters, core counting, and optional ads (banner plus occasional interstitial). Premium unlocks unlimited counters, history, volume-button counting, extra widget layouts, and no ads.

items.question: Does TallyNudge have Home Screen widgets?
items.answer: Not in 0.9.0. The Widgets tab shows four in-app preview layouts so you can pick how a counter looks. Those are not iOS or Android Home Screen widgets.

items.question: What is the Premium product ID?
items.answer: tallynudge_premium. Recommended price USD $2.99, one-time, not a subscription. Payments are processed by Apple or Google.

items.question: Does TallyNudge show ads?
items.answer: Yes on the free plan: Google AdMob banner and interstitial with a 4-minute cooldown. Premium removes ads.

items.question: Can I count with volume buttons?
items.answer: Yes on Premium. Volume up increments, volume down decrements, so you can keep your eyes on the set.

items.question: Where are my counters stored?
items.answer: On your device. Uninstalling the app deletes local counters and history.

items.question: How do I restore Premium?
items.answer: Open Settings and tap Restore purchases with the same Apple ID or Google account. Product ID: tallynudge_premium.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for TallyNudge — Tally Counter & Clicker.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use TallyNudge and related pages at zukiapps.com/tally-nudge.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the TallyNudge app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: TallyNudge is designed to work on-device. We collect limited data to run the app and optional purchases.
items: Counter names, values, history, and Premium status stored on device
Crash and usage diagnostics sent to Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics
Advertising identifiers if you allow tracking (iOS App Tracking Transparency)
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Operate and improve TallyNudge
Show ads to free players (Google AdMob)
Respond to support requests
Validate in-app purchases
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: Free players may see Google AdMob banners and interstitials (about a 4-minute cooldown). On iOS we request tracking permission before personalized ads.
section4.content2: You can limit ad tracking in system settings. Premium removes ads.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Counter data remains on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Google AdMob (ads), Firebase (Crashlytics and Analytics), Apple App Store, and Google Play Billing may process data under their policies.
section6.content2: Crash reports are sent with Firebase Crashlytics in release builds. We do not sell your personal information.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: TallyNudge is a general-audience utility. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.
